name: Sample benchmark (Halcyon Ridge demo)
description: DEMONSTRATION BENCHMARK over the three fictional sample documents. 18 answerable questions with verbatim evidence passages and key facts, plus 4 unanswerable questions that test abstention. Results on this benchmark describe this tiny demo corpus only and are not a general measure of model accuracy.

items.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
items.expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accruing at 1.5 days per completed month of service.
evidence: Full-time employees receive 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

items.question: Can I carry unused annual leave into next year, and is there a deadline?
items.expected_answer: Yes, up to 5 days of unused annual leave can be carried over; carried-over days must be used by 31 March or they are forfeited.
evidence: Up to 5 days of unused annual leave can be carried over into the next year; carried-over days must be used by 31 March or they are forfeited.

items.question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
items.expected_answer: A medical certificate is required for any absence of more than two consecutive days.
evidence: A medical certificate is required for any absence of more than two consecutive days.

items.question: How long is the probation period and can it be extended?
items.expected_answer: Probation lasts three months and may be extended once by up to three additional months if agreed objectives have not been met.
evidence: All new employees serve a probation period of three months.
Probation may be extended once, by up to three additional months, if agreed objectives have not been met.

items.question: Which days am I expected to be in the office?
items.expected_answer: Employees work from the office at least two days per week; Tuesday and Thursday are the anchor days when everyone is expected in the office.
evidence: Employees work from the office at least two days per week, and Tuesday and Thursday are the team anchor days on which everyone is expected in the office.

items.question: How many days per year can I work remotely from another country, and whose approval do I need?
items.expected_answer: Up to 20 working days per calendar year, with written approval from both your manager and the People & Culture team at least 10 business days before travel.
evidence: Employees may work remotely from another country for up to 20 working days per calendar year.
Working from abroad requires written approval from both your manager and the People & Culture team at least 10 business days before travel

items.question: What is the annual learning and development budget?
items.expected_answer: Each employee has an annual learning budget of SGD 1,200; single requests above SGD 500 need manager approval in advance.
evidence: Every employee has an annual learning budget of SGD 1,200 for courses, certifications and conferences.

items.question: What is the deadline for submitting expense claims and where are they submitted?
items.expected_answer: Expenses must be submitted through the Ledgerly expense portal within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred, with an itemised receipt.
evidence: Business expenses must be submitted through the Ledgerly expense portal within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred

items.question: What is the first response time and resolution target for a P1 critical incident?
items.expected_answer: P1 incidents get a first response within 15 minutes, 24 hours a day, with a target resolution within 4 hours.
evidence: First response within 15 minutes, 24 hours a day. Target resolution within 4 hours.

items.question: Who must be notified during a P1 incident and how quickly?
items.expected_answer: An Incident Commander is appointed immediately and the Chief Technology Officer must be notified within 30 minutes.
evidence: An Incident Commander is appointed immediately and the Chief Technology Officer must be notified within 30 minutes.

items.question: When is a P2 incident escalated from the service desk to Platform Engineering?
items.expected_answer: P1 and P2 incidents are escalated from L1 to L2 (Platform Engineering) if there is no progress within 30 minutes.
evidence: P1 and P2 incidents are escalated from L1 to L2 if there is no progress within 30 minutes.

items.question: How quickly must a lost or stolen laptop be reported?
items.expected_answer: Lost or stolen laptops, phones and access badges must be reported to the IT service desk within 2 hours of discovery.
evidence: Lost or stolen laptops, phones and access badges must be reported to the IT service desk within 2 hours of discovery.

items.question: What are the password length and MFA requirements?
items.expected_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all accounts; passwords are changed only when compromise is suspected.
evidence: Passwords for company accounts must be at least 14 characters long. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all accounts.

items.question: Within how many days must a post-incident review be held for P1 and P2 incidents?
items.expected_answer: Within 5 business days of resolution; the review is blameless.
evidence: A post-incident review is mandatory for every P1 and P2 incident and must be held within 5 business days of resolution.

items.question: How much does the Beacon Growth plan cost and does it include SSO?
items.expected_answer: Growth costs USD 99 per user per month and includes single sign-on (SSO) with SAML 2.0, 250 GB storage and role-based access control.
evidence: Growth costs USD 99 per user per month. It includes 250 GB of managed storage, single sign-on (SSO) with SAML 2.0, and role-based access control.

items.question: Can a customer get a refund on an annual Beacon subscription?
items.expected_answer: Annual subscriptions can be cancelled within the first 30 days for a prorated refund of the unused months; after 30 days they are not refundable. Monthly subscriptions are not refundable.
evidence: Annual subscriptions can be cancelled within the first 30 days for a prorated refund of the unused months.

items.question: Which data residency regions does Beacon offer?
items.expected_answer: Singapore, Frankfurt or Northern Virginia, chosen when the workspace is created.
evidence: Customers choose a data residency region when the workspace is created: Singapore, Frankfurt or Northern Virginia.

items.question: A customer reports a full outage of Beacon. How should it be handled internally and how fast must customers be contacted?
items.expected_answer: A customer-reported outage is handled as a P1 incident under the IT Support and Incident Escalation Policy; for customer-facing P1 incidents Customer Success must send the first customer communication within 1 hour.
evidence: Internally, a customer-reported outage is handled as a P1 incident under the IT Support and Incident Escalation Policy.
For customer-facing P1 incidents, the Customer Success team must send the first customer communication within 1 hour of the incident being declared.
